Extent to which a cause (x) and an effect (y) occur together or vary together in the way predicted by the hypothesis under consideration (Positive correlation between x and y)

w4.11:
Inference and Hypothesis Testing
Assess whether the null hypothesis is the correct view of the world by creating a test which shows whether there is at least a 5% (usually) chance that it is correct. 
If we find that there is less than a 5% chance of the null being correct, then we “do not find support for the null hypothesis." This implies that the alternate hypothesis is one explanation for what is happening in the population.
